From 7807bf28fe02a76bf112916c6b9194f282f5e43c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Matthew Brost <matthew.brost@intel.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2021 09:04:55 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/guc: Only assign guc_id.id when stealing guc_id

Previously assigned whole guc_id structure (list, spin lock) which is
incorrect, only assign the guc_id.id.

Fixes: 0f7976506de61 ("drm/i915/guc: Rework and simplify locking")
Signed-off-by: Matthew Brost <matthew.brost@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: John Harrison <John.C.Harrison@Intel.com>
Signed-off-by: John Harrison <John.C.Harrison@Intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20211214170500.28569-3-matthew.brost@intel.com
(cherry picked from commit 939d8e9c87e704fd5437e2c8b80929591fe540eb)
Signed-off-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_submission.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_submission.c
index c50039a5ba1e..302e9ff0602c 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_submission.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_submission.c
@@ -1662,7 +1662,7 @@ static int steal_guc_id(struct intel_guc *guc, struct intel_context *ce)
 		GEM_BUG_ON(intel_context_is_parent(cn));
 
 		list_del_init(&cn->guc_id.link);
-		ce->guc_id = cn->guc_id;
+		ce->guc_id.id = cn->guc_id.id;
 
 		spin_lock(&cn->guc_state.lock);
 		clr_context_registered(cn);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_submission.c`**
   - **Line Change**: The line that previously assigned the entire `guc_id` structure (`ce->guc_id = cn->guc_id;`) has been modified to only assign the `id` field of the `guc_id` structure (`ce->guc_id.id = cn->guc_id.id;`).

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in the `intel_guc_submission.c` file addresses a bug where the entire `guc_id` structure was incorrectly assigned when "stealing" the `guc_id`. The fix ensures that only the `id` part of the `guc_id` is assigned, which aligns with the intended functionality and prevents potential issues related to the incorrect handling of the `guc_id` structure (such as improper locking or list management). This change is a refinement of the locking mechanism introduced in a previous commit, ensuring that the code behaves correctly in the context of managing GPU contexts.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
ce->guc_id = cn->guc_id;
```
Reason:
This statement assigns the entire `guc_id` structure from `cn` to `ce`, which includes the list and spin lock. This incorrect assignment can lead to improper management of these resources, potentially causing race conditions or synchronization issues in the GPU context handling.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
ce->guc_id.id = cn->guc_id.id;
```
Reason:
This statement correctly assigns only the `id` field of the `guc_id` structure from `cn` to `ce`, avoiding the incorrect assignment of the entire structure. This ensures that the list and spin lock remain properly managed and prevents potential race conditions or synchronization issues.
